fallos_mitigaciones: Sec.4 'Inaccuracies': the self-verification module can fail (e.g. not recognizing spider string as a success signal after beating a spider); mitigated partially by the automatic curriculum's flexibility to reattempt the task later. Sec.4 'Hallucinations': the automatic curriculum occasionally proposes unachievable tasks referencing non-existent items (e.g. 'copper sword'), and GPT-4 hallucinates during code generation (e.g. wrong block/material names); mitigated by the iterative prompting loop (environment feedback + execution errors feed back into the next code-refinement round, up to 4 rounds) though not fully solved.

fallos_mitigaciones: Sec.5 (L6/Beads discussion): 'AI agent CLIs lose context in multiple ways -- conversation compaction discards older messages, session restarts clear the context window, switching CLI backends starts a fresh session with no memory of prior work, and rate limits can kill a session mid-task'; mitigated by the Beads external versioned work ledger (Dolt-backed), so an incoming/restarted agent reads bd list and resumes exactly where its predecessor left off instead of a cold-start re-scan that risks duplicating claimed work.
cita: Anderson (2026). The AI Codebase Maturity Model: From Assisted Coding to Fully Autonomous Systems.
notes: F differs from F_screening (MULTIAGENTE only): added WRITE (Beads ledger claims/writes) and FIDELIDAD (explicit audit trail). Level-6/Sec.5 'Work Coordination: Beads': open-source distributed issue tracker (Steve Yegge) backed by Dolt (versioned SQL DB); each agent claims work with 'bd add --actor', queries unclaimed items 'bd list --status=open', skips items claimed by other actors, and records completion status/notes -> operaciones=WRITE;ACTUALIZACION, retrieval=GREP-ARCHIVOS (CLI status/actor queries, no embeddings/ranking/graph), trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA (agent start/restart triggers a ledger read). Sec.5 explicitly: 'Beads also solves a subtler problem: agent memory continuity... The agent's memory lives in the ledger, not in the conversation history' -> mem_tipos=TRABAJO (task/work-state memory, not episodic/semantic narrative). 'structured work items with actor ownership, dependency chains, and a full audit trail' -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI/FIDELIDAD; work-item status ('what's in progress, what's done') is itself progress-state content -> plan_estado=SI; what travels between agents/sessions is both claim ownership (PUNTEROS: who claimed what) and the work-item content/notes (CONTENIDO) -> handoff=PUNTEROS;CONTENIDO. This is a practitioner case-study/production report (4-month KubeStellar Console L1-L5 + 1-week Hive L6 deployment), not a controlled ablation isolating Beads specifically (no with/without-ledger experiment) -> evidencia_tipo=CUALITATIVA, plus quantified production throughput/latency claims (91% coverage, bug-to-fix <30min, feature-to-impl <60min, '5x PR throughput and 37x issue throughput from Level 2 to Level 6' per abstract) -> also MEDICION-COSTO, metricas=LATENCIA;OTRA. No named external benchmark dataset (real production repo) -> benchmarks=NINGUNO. mide_lectura=NO: no isolated measurement of the utility/precision of READING the Beads ledger specifically (the throughput numbers are whole-system L1-L6 progression, not a memory-read ablation) -> F has no RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO. Hive coordinates a fleet of role-specialized agents (scanner/reviewer/architect/outreach) via the shared ledger -> multiagente=SI. alcance=PROYECTO (bounded to the KubeStellar org's ~4 repos, not a multi-tenant organization).
